y-m-70-09.topic: Ii-conic sections: iindawo zeparabola nomgca, imigca ethinteleyo
y-m-70-09.goal: Gweba isibakala 'ukuba sidibana kwichaphaza elinye, sisithinteleyo' usebenzisa ubungqina bekwitheyibhile uze ukhangele umzekelo ochasayo, yakha imibini (m, n) enika imigca ethinteleyo yeparabola ngokwakho, uze ucacise imeko ekungenakwahlulwa yi-discriminant.
y-m-70-09.material:
Kukho iparabola C: y²=4x kunye nomgca l_m: y=mx+1 (m linani lenyani). (y² ifundwa "y isikwere".) UJisu wathi, "Umgca odibana neparabola kwichaphaza elinye kuphela ngumgca othinteleyo." Iziphumo zokufaka umgca kulingano luka-C nokwenza lula, namachaphaza okudibana, ngezi ngezantsi.
m | ulingano emva kokufaka | ukudibana
−1 | x²−6x+1=0 | amachaphaza amabini
0 | −4x+1=0 | ichaphaza elinye (1/4, 1)
1 | x²−2x+1=0 | ichaphaza elinye (1, 2)
2 | 4x²+1=0 | akukho
Nqaku: Umgca othinteleyo kwichaphaza (x₁, y₁) elikuC yi-y₁·y=2(x+x₁) (ifomula yomgca othinteleyo).

y-m-70-09.s.s1.hint.1: Zoba umfanekiso uze uthelekise ukuba umgca ngamnye ujongene njani nemilo yeparabola.

Umgca y=1 uyafana ne-eksisi (i-eksisi ye-x) yeparabola, ngoko nangona udibana kwichaphaza elinye, asingomgca othinteleyo. Umzekelo omnye ochasayo wenza isitatimenti sikaJisu sibe xoki. Kwelinye icala, m=1 uyafana nomgca othinteleyo y=x+1, ngoko ngumgca othinteleyo.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.prompt: Yenza imibini ema-3 (m, n), enom ohlukeneyo, apho umgca y=mx+n ngumgca othinteleyo weparabola y²=4x. (Susa imigca eyafana ne-eksisi neyo yemo x=k. Ungasebenzisa amadesimali.)

y-m-70-03.title: Ngaba umgca onethambeka elifanayo ne-asymptote awudibani ne-hyperbola?
y-m-70-03.topic: Amacandelo e-conic: izikhundla ze-asymptote ze-hyperbola nomgca
y-m-70-03.goal: Vavanya ukwenza ngokubanzi okwakhiwe ngokufaka i-asymptote enye ngemigca eyongezelelweyo uze uhlaziye umgwebo wakho, uze usebenzise isiphumo ukwakha imizekelo yemigca enethambeka elifanayo ngokwakho.
y-m-70-03.material: Ii-asymptote ze-hyperbola H: x²/4 − y²/9 = 1 (funda: x isikwere phezu kwe-4 ukuncitshiswa nge-y isikwere phezu kwe-9 silingana no-1) zi-y=(3/2)x kunye ne-y=−(3/2)x. USoyoung wathi: "Umgca onethambeka elifanayo ne-asymptote awuze udibane ne-H. I-asymptote isondela kuphela ngokusondela kwi-H ngaphandle kokuyithinta." Masivavanye ingxelo kaSoyoung ngokujonga izinto ezingezantsi enye ngexesha.

y-m-70-02.s.s2.o.c: Akwazeki. I-PF ayinakugqitha iarksi enkulu esisiqingatha 5
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.c: Iarksi enkulu esisiqingatha ngumgama ukusuka kwiziko ukuya kwincopho. Ubungakanani obahlukileyo kumgama ukusuka kwifokhasi ukuya kwiphuzu kwi-ellipse.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.d: Kubonakala ngathi umisele ubude 10 bearksi enkulu belingana nomahluko wemigama emibini, hayi isixa.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.explain: Ubude bearksi enkulu bungu-10, ngoko PF+PF′=10. I-PF ngu-5−4=1 kwincopho esondele kakhulu naku-5+4=9 kwincopho ekude kakhulu, ngoko inokuthatha onke amaxabiso phakathi kwe-1 ne-9. U-7 ungaphakathi koloo luhlu, yaye emva koko PF′=10−7=3.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.prompt: Kwi-ellipse efanayo, yenza ibini ezi-3 ezilandelelanisiweyo (p, q) apho kukho ngokwenene iphuzu P elinoku-PF=p kunye ne-PF′=q. (Ukutshintsha i-p ne-q kubalwa njengomzekelo ofanayo. Unokusebenzisa iidesimali.)
y-m-70-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuba i-p+q kufuneka ibe yintoni, uze uhlole ukuba ukukhetha i-p enye kumisela i-q na.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.hint.1: Zama i-p encinci kuno-1 okanye enkulu kuno-9 uze ucinge ukuba iphuzu elinjalo linokuba kwi-ellipse ngokwenene na.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.ok.c1: Isixa semigama emibini singu-10, ubude bearksi enkulu.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.fail.c1: p+q ayingu-10. Sasiyintoni isixa semigama ukuya kumafokhasi amabini alo ellipse?
y-m-70-02.s.s3.ok.c2: Ingaphakathi koluhlu lwemigama iphuzu elikwi-ellipse elinokuba nayo.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Umgama ukusuka kwiphuzu elikwi-ellipse ukuya kwifokhasi awunakuba mncinci kuno-1. Khumbula umgama kwincopho esondele kakhulu.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.explain: p+q=10, yaye ixabiso le-PF liphuma ku-1 (incopho esondele kakhulu) ukuya ku-9 (incopho ekude kakhulu), ngoko i-p ne-q kufuneka zombini zibe ubuncinane 1. Zonke iibini ezilandelelanisiweyo ezine-p phakathi kwe-1 ne-9, ezifana no-(3, 7), (5, 5) kunye no-(1, 9), ziyakwazeka.

y-m-70-04.title: Ukuba iimveliso zamachaphaza ziyalingana, ingaba ii-vektha ezimbini nazo ziyalingana?
y-m-70-04.prereq.0: Thatha ukuba umfundi ufunda isifundo se-'Geometry' sokukhetha sesikolo samabanga aphezulu. I-'H2' yinqanaba lobunzima nenkxaso kuphela kwesi sabelo sokuvelisa; ayithethi ukuba iSebe lezeMfundo lisabela eso sifundo kwibanga elithile.
y-m-70-04.topic: Ii-vektha zeplani: iipropati zemveliso yamachaphaza nemizekelo echasayo
y-m-70-04.goal: Vavanya ngomzekelo ochasayo ukuba umgaqo wokucima obambayo kumanani ('ukuba ab=ac kwaye a≠0 ke b=c') ubamba nakwimveliso yamachaphaza yee-vektha, uze ukhethe imiqathango eyenza ukuba ubambe.
y-m-70-04.material: Kumanani, ukuba a≠0 kwaye ab=ac, ke b=c. UJeonghyeok wacinga ukuba ii-vektha zisebenza ngokufanayo waza wathi: "Xa a=(2, 1), ukuba a·b=a·c ke b=c." (a·b yimveliso yamachaphaza ye-a ne-b, oko kukuthi, ixabiso olifumana ngokuphindaphinda amacandelo wongeze. Zonke ii-vektha zikwiplani yee-koodinethi.)
y-m-70-04.thinking.0: Ukuthandabuza ukuba umgaqo wamanani unokuhanjiswa kwezinye izinto
y-m-70-04.thinking.1: Ukwakha ngokwakho umzekelo ochasayo oyanelisa imiqathango
y-m-70-04.prereq.1: Ifom yamacandelo yee-vektha zeplani nemveliso yamachaphaza a·b=a₁b₁+a₂b₂
y-m-70-04.prereq.2: Iipropati zemveliso yamachaphaza xa ii-vektha ezimbini ziyafana okanye ziime nkqo
y-m-70-04.s.s1.prompt: Ukufumanisa ukuba ingxelo kaJeonghyeok ihlala ibamba na, yeyiphi (b, c) eya kuba luncedo kakhulu ukuyivavanya?
y-m-70-04.s.s1.hint.0: Xa ibango linefom 'ukuba imeko ke isiphelo', umzekelo ophula ibango kufuneka wanelise ntoni yaye aphule ntoni, imeko okanye isiphelo?
y-m-70-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qala ukhethe i-vektha enye apho imveliso yamachaphaza ne-a=(2, 1) yaziwayo, uze utshintshe amacandelo ayo uze ufune enye i-vektha apho imveliso yamachaphaza ihlala injalo.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.a: Vavanya iibini ezininzi apho i-b ne-c yivektha enye
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba b=c, a·b=a·c ihlala ibamba. Ezi zibini azinakuphula ibango.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.b: Vavanya kuphela ii-vektha ezinecala elifanayo ne-a
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.b: Uvavanya ityala elikhethekileyo kuphela. Nokuba libamba apho, awunakwazi ngezinye iimeko.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.c: Ubungakanani abunayo mpawu ngqo nokubamba kwalo bango.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.d: Kuba ibango lithi 'rhoqo', le ngcamango ifuna ibini elanelisa imeko kodwa liphikisana nesiphelo.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.explain: Ibango 'rhoqo' liqhekezwa libini elinye elanelisa imeko (a·b=a·c) ngelixa liphikisana nesiphelo (b=c). Ngoko eyona nto inenzuzo kukuzifunela ibini elinjalo.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.prompt: Kwi-a=(2, 1), yenza iibini ezi-2 zee-vektha b=(b₁, b₂), c=(c₁, c₂) ezinoku-a·b=a·c kodwa b≠c. Iibini ezimbini kufuneka zibe no-b−c owahlukileyo (ukutshintsha i-b ne-c, okanye ukutshintsha kuphela umqondiso we-b−c, kubalwa njengomzekelo ofanayo).
y-m-70-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe i-b enye uze ubale i-a·b.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga ukuba i-a·c itshintsha kangakanani xa utshintsha elinye icandelo le-c, uze utshintshe elinye icandelo ngokufanelekileyo ukubuyisela imveliso yamachaphaza.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Bala i-a·b=2b₁+b₂ kunye ne-a·c=2c₁+c₂ ngokwahlukileyo. Amaxabiso omabini awalingani.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.fail.c2: b no-c yi-vector efanayo. Kufuneka zahluke ukuze zibe ngumzekelo ochasayo.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo: ukuba b=(1, 3), c=(2, 1), ngoko a·b=2+3=5 kwaye a·c=4+1=5 ziyalingana kodwa b≠c. b−c ihlala iphuma ngefom (t, −2t), icala elithe nkqo ku-a. Ngoko ungayihambisa i-vector nangayiphi inani kwicala elithe nkqo ku-a.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.prompt: Uqinisekisile ukuba ingxelo ayihlali ibamba. Khetha zonke iimeko ezongezelelweyo ezilandelayo ezenza 'ukuba a·b=a·c ngoko b=c' ibambe. (a ayiyi-zero vector.)
y-m-70-04.s.s3.hint.0: Phinda ubhale imeko nganye njengokuba b−c kufuneka ibe yi-vector enjani. a·(b−c)=0 ithetha ntoni?
y-m-70-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kwimeko nganye, khangela ngokuthe ngqo isibini esine-b≠c xa a=(2, 1). Ukuba usifumana, loo meko ayonelanga.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.a: Ukuba nobukhulu obufanayo akwenzi i-vector ibe yinye. Hlola ukuba b=(1, 3), c=(3, −1) iyanelisa imeko xa a=(2, 1).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.o.b: a·b=a·c ibamba kuyo yonke i-vector a kwiplani
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.b: Le ngcinga itshintsha a ngelixa ibeka imeko ukuze b−c ibe nkqo kuyo yonke icala.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.c: Ulahlekelwe kukuba zikho ii-vector ezininzi ngokungenasiphelo ezime nkqo ku-a emgceni omnye. Umzekelo, cinga nge-(1, −2) ne-(2, −4).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.d: Le ngcinga isebenzisa inyaniso yokuba ii-vector ezisemgceni omnye zilungiswa omnye ngomnye ngobukhulu bazo (i-dot product).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.explain: Kuba a·(b−c)=0, kwanele ukuba b−c ime nkqo ku-a. (b) Ukuba ibamba kuyo yonke a, ngoko b−c ime nkqo kuyo yonke icala, ngoko yi-zero vector. (d) Ukuba b=sa kunye no-c=ta, ngoko s|a|²=t|a|² inika s=t. (a) Ukuba b=(1, 3), c=(3, −1), ubukhulu buyalingana kwaye a·b=a·c=5, kodwa b≠c. (c) (1, −2) kunye ne-(2, −4) zombini zime nkqo ku-a ngoko i-dot product yazo i-0, kodwa zahlukile enye kwenye.
